decisions.reason: As a black-finish variant close to the established range, it is likely to meet the firm's aspirations, and slack allows it to be carried if still uncertain.
A shower channel for seamless coverings presented on its own page fits the established offer and shows enough market support to keep.
Though pump-assisted, it builds on the firm's established drainage technology and, given organizational slack, uncertainty does not justify dropping it.
